== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes do not prioritize themselves when selecting a target for this skill, even though it would reduce its own recharge. Accordingly, even with high attribute investment, their ability to maintain it on a caster-heavy team (without microing) is poor.
* Heroes will cast Weapon of Quickening on [[Spellcaster|spellcasting]] professions regardless of weapon type equipped.
